topIssues.title: Flaky test: TestPreinteropFaultProofs_VariedBlockTimes
topIssues.author: ajsutton
topIssues.body:
**Claude:** Reporting flaky test.

## Flaky Test

- **Test:** `TestPreinteropFaultProofs_VariedBlockTimes` (and `_FasterChainB` variant)
- **Package:** `github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/op-acceptance-tests/tests/isthmus/preinterop`
- **Status:** Currently skipped with `t.Skip("Skipping flaky varied block time fault proof test")`
- **Related:** ethereum-optimism/optimism#19010

## Context

The test configures two interop chains with different block times (1s and 2s), freezes batchers, captures L1 heads at different batch-availability points, then runs super-root transition test cases through both kona interop FPP and challenger trace provider.

The test was skipped due to observed flakiness. Investigating root cause.

topPRs.title: op-interop-filter: add sender allow-listing
topPRs.author: karlfloersch
topPRs.body:
## Summary
- add an `allowed-senders` policy to `op-interop-filter` and reject interop transactions from unauthorized senders unless passthrough is explicitly enabled
- thread the interop transaction sender through the Go and Rust `CheckAccessList` client paths so txpool validation can enforce the policy at the filter
- update supervisor/filter tests and interop call sites for the new RPC argument and unauthorized-sender error path

## Testing
- go test ./op-interop-filter/filter ./op-service/sources ./op-supervisor/supervisor/...

## Notes
- `allowed-senders` is required unless `--dangerously-enable-passthrough` is set
- the supervisor-side API surface is updated for compatibility, but sender enforcement lives in `op-interop-filter`

topPRs.title: feat(kona-host): add directory-based kv store compatible with op-program
topPRs.author: ajsutton
topPRs.body:
## Summary

- Add `DirectoryKeyValueStore` to kona-host that writes preimages in op-program's `DataFormatDirectory` layout
- Path layout: `<dir>/<first4hex>/<rest>.txt` with hex-encoded values, matching Go's `directoryKV`
- Writes `kvformat` marker file (`"directory"`) so op-challenger's existing autodetection works
- Add `--data-format` CLI option (default: `directory`, also supports `rocksdb`)
- RocksDB `DiskKeyValueStore` preserved as an option

## Motivation

kona-host uses RocksDB for preimage storage, but op-challenger reads preimages using op-program's flat-file format. Pebble (Go) cannot read RocksDB data (`pebble: corrupt manifest`). This format mismatch causes test failures when switching e2e tests from op-program to kona-host.

By defaulting to the same directory format as op-program, kona-host becomes a drop-in replacement for preimage storage.

## Test plan

- [x] `cargo check --package kona-host` compiles (no Rust errors)
- [x] Proptest roundtrip test for DirectoryKeyValueStore
- [x] kvformat marker file test
- [x] Key path layout test
- [ ] CI: kona-host Rust tests pass
- [ ] Integration: op-challenger can read preimages from kona-host directory format
